title: Vector monitor
description: A circular signal grows into fine radial strokes around a live elapsed-time readout.
useCase: Visual feedback for signal tests, audio audition, or capture interfaces.
interaction: Start and stop the simulated signal
reducedMotion: The radial signal and elapsed clock freeze; the signal state remains operable.
limitations: Procedural signal only. No microphone capture, audio analysis, or stored recording.
look: Deep oxblood field with a ring of fine cream radial strokes and amber ticks around a double circle, a large centred timer and pill button.
motion: Lobes of longer radial strokes travel around the ring as two sine waves drift in phase, an amber dot orbits slowly and the timer counts up; stopping collapses the strokes.
adapt: Everything is drawn in `draw`: 144 strokes whose length comes from `signal` times `envelope`, plus the `sweep` dot and `clock` readout. Replace `signal` with analyser levels for real audio, and tune the `time` multipliers and stroke colours.
